# opstracer_routing_rules (Resource)

All alert routing rules of the org, in evaluation order: the first matching rule picks the escalation policy, otherwise the service policy applies. Authoritative: rules not listed here are deleted. Use one instance per org.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Evaluated top to bottom; the first match picks the policy.
resource "opstracer_routing_rules" "org" {
  rules = [
    {
      escalation_policy_id = opstracer_escalation_policy.backend.id
      severities           = ["P1", "P2"]
      source_type          = "datadog"
      tags                 = { team = "backend", env = "prod" }
    },
    {
      escalation_policy_id = opstracer_escalation_policy.backend.id
      enabled              = false
      tags                 = { env = "staging" }
    },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `rules` (Attributes List) Rules in evaluation order. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `routing_rules`.

<a id="nestedatt--rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules`

Required:

- `escalation_policy_id` (String) Escalation policy to page when the rule matches.

Optional:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Set to false to keep the rule without evaluating it.
- `integration_id` (String) Match alerts from this integration only.
- `routing_hints` (Map of String) Routing hints on the alert that must all match.
- `severities` (Set of String) Match any of P1 ... P5.
- `source_type` (String) Match alerts from this integration type: `alertmanager`, `datadog`, `generic`, `grafana`, `newrelic`, `pagerduty`, `railway`, `sentry`, `supabase`, `vercel`.
- `tags` (Map of String) Alert tags that must all match.

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Rule ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import opstracer_routing_rules.org routing_rules
```
